subject.title: fix(models): clear stale auth cooldowns after early limit resets

question: Should OpenClaw standardize the profile-scoped `models auth clear-cooldown` command as the supported recovery surface for provider billing or usage recovery, rather than pursue automatic re-probing or a different recovery experience?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but selecting a permanent public recovery contract for persisted provider disablement determines operator workflow, documentation, and future compatibility expectations.

options.title: Approve the explicit CLI recovery path
options.body: Keep the command narrowly scoped to persisted profile state and require complete redacted real-flow proof before merge.

options.title: Prefer automatic recovery behavior
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers define provider re-probing or cooldown-policy behavior that avoids requiring operator intervention.

options.title: Use a different supported recovery surface
options.body: Close or redirect the command in favor of an approved doctor or in-product recovery flow with the same ownership and safety guarantees.

recommendation.title: Approve the explicit CLI recovery path
recommendation.body: Keep the command narrowly scoped to persisted profile state and require complete redacted real-flow proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision directly concerns persisted auth-profile recovery and provider-routing safety.
